# Sales Templates

**← Back to [EAP Home](../../../README.md) • [Resources](../../README.md) • [Work Templates](../README.md)**

> Templates and checklists for the sales and pre-sales process. These capture solution requirements that drive infrastructure sizing, cost estimation, and environment provisioning by ITO.

[resources/work-templates/sales/README.md#usage]

## Usage

These templates support the sales process by providing:

- Standardized capture of hosting, compute, storage, and networking requirements
- Consistent inputs for ITO infrastructure sizing and cost modeling
- Clear documentation of scalability, disaster recovery, and compliance needs
- Alignment between sales commitments and infrastructure delivery
